allowed_operations: Check existence and regular non-symlink status
Read complete compressed bytes in binary mode solely for whole-file SHA-256
Two complete SHA-256 passes on one open descriptor to check repeatability of the read
Check descriptor and path metadata before, between and after passes; acquire shared advisory lock
Create only new prospective authorization and result audit artifacts
authorization_source: Explicit user approval in this chat: E1-CODE — Aprobación prospectiva y ejecución del Permiso A
consistency_limit: Shared lock is advisory. Matching descriptor/path metadata and two complete digests provide an operational consistency check, not a filesystem snapshot or guarantee against future mutation.

decision_rules.FAIL: Consistent complete read yields a SHA-256 unequal to expected.
decision_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: Source missing/nonregular/symlink, lock or read failure, identity/metadata change, unequal repeated reads or uncertain consistency.
decision_rules.PASS: Regular non-symlink source; both complete reads have identical SHA-256 equal to the expected value; observed source metadata and byte counts remain stable. Size is auxiliary.

excluded_operations: T1/T2 record display, logging or analysis
historical_contract_policy: Prospective additional authorization only; no rewriting, replacement or retrospective reinterpretation.
limited_exception: Physical reading of all compressed bytes, including bytes encoding T2, is authorized only for whole-file integrity; decompression and record interpretation remain prohibited.
mandatory_stop: Stop immediately after recording Permission A result. B and C require separate explicit authorization.
